title: Brazil's CSN agrees to sell cement unit to China's Huaxin
summary: Brazil's CSN agrees to sell cement unit to China's Huaxin
body_markdown: **Brazil:** On 7 November 2026 Brazil’s CSN signed an agreement to sell its cement unit, CSN Cimentos, to China’s Huaxin, in a deal valuing the business at US$2.3bn. In a securities filing, CSN Cimentos said the transaction marked an important step in its strategy to reduce debt.
